HOW IT WORKS

Simple, and in your control.

Orderly matches English product names against your menu and looks for quantities, dates and collection details. It uses local text rules, not a language model.

Review every draft against the original message. Changes such as “make it four instead”, pack sizes, other languages and unusual wording may need manual corrections.

It does not read WhatsApp, send messages, take payments or verify dietary suitability. Copy a draft reply only after checking it. Your saved orders remain on this device.

Sample orders are fictional. This prototype has no claimed customers, revenue or measured time savings.
